title: 21 CFR Part 11; Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures, Electronic Copies of Electronic Records
withdrawal_statement: In the Federal Register of February 4, 2003 (68 FR 5645), we announced the withdrawal of the draft guidance for industry, 21 CFR Part 11; Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures, Electronic Copies of Electronic Records.
